title: Derived crossing and overlay-transition analysis
description: Derive ordered enter/exit crossings and gained/lost/shared Overlay transitions for directed and bidirectional Resource communication.
completion_criteria: Crossing order follows source-inner exits then target-outer enters.
Bidirectional reverse traversal is the exact inverse.
Overlay transition sets are stable and explicit.
Results do not change with layout geometry.
Legacy assertions are diagnosed when they disagree with derived results.
triage_notes: Implemented analyzeTopology as a layout-independent public API. Verified ordered crossings, exact bidirectional inversion, stable explicit overlay transitions, legacy assertion diagnostics, endpoint/reference diagnostics, typecheck, focused tests (18 passing), production build, and AOF organization verification (46/46).
